name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle and two or three wheels on the ground; a motor-driven cycle or motorized bicycle operated past 30 mph is one. Defined by 18 DCMR 9901.1 and D.C. Code §31-2402(16), as amended by the Motorized Bicycle Amendment Act of 2012 (D.C. Law 19-290).

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle and two or three wheels on the ground; a three-wheeled vehicle with a cab and windshield isn't one
A motor-driven cycle or motorized bicycle becomes one when operated past 30 mph
Rider and passenger must wear a protective helmet
Carries a passenger only on a seat designed for one, or a sidecar
A motor vehicle under DC's compulsory insurance law
